_comment: Shared parser parity corpus. Every port (TS @flashkarte/shared, Python flashmd) must parse each `input` into `expected`. Scope is the COMMON feature set — basic cards, Q:/A: cards, categories, paragraph handling, title fallback. Branching (anchors + options) is NOT here because the Python reference parser does not implement it; branching parity is covered by the TS and Kotlin suites. Cards compare on {front, back, category} only.

cases.name: categories carry to following cards
cases.input:
# D

## Cat A

**1. X**
x def.

## Cat B

**2. Y**
y def.

cases.name: multi-line single paragraph joined with space
cases.input:
# D

**1. X**
line one.
line two.

cases.name: multi-paragraph back split by blank line
cases.input:
# D

**1. X**
para one.

para two.

cases.name: Q:/A: answer and description become separate paragraphs
cases.input:
# AI

Q: ML
A: Machine Learning
A subfield of AI.

cards.back:
Machine Learning

A subfield of AI.

cases.name: Q:/A: with no description yields just the answer
a back line starting with A: in bold format is preserved
cases.input:
# D

**1. FOO**
A: this is just back text.

cards.back: A: this is just back text.

cases.name: no title falls back to the source filename
no card patterns yields an empty deck
cases.input:
# Empty Deck
No card patterns here.

cases.name: card without a category is null
